source: Things to do in Raleigh this Weekend! — Thingstodo919

events.name: Beer, Bourbon & BBQ Festival 2026
events.tagline: Two days of beer, bourbon, barbecue, and live music at Koka Booth Amphitheatre.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 6–10 PM · Sat 12–6 PM VIP, 2–6 PM GA
events.description: The Beer, Bourbon & BBQ Festival returns to Cary for two days with 60+ beers, 40+ bourbons, barbecue, tasting seminars, games, and live entertainment. Guests must be 21 or older to sample alcohol.

events.name: Durham Bulls vs. Gwinnett Stripers
events.tagline: The Bulls face Gwinnett under the lights at the DBAP, with Friday Night Fireworks after the game.
events.description: Minor League Baseball game between the Durham Bulls and Gwinnett Stripers at Durham Bulls Athletic Park. Gates open at 5:30 p.m., and the Friday night game includes fireworks after the final out.

events.name: Discover Dance: DISHOOM
events.tagline: A high-energy, free dance party with live music and step-by-step instruction at Downtown Cary Park.
events.description: Discover Dance: DISHOOM returns to Downtown Cary Park with DJ Rang, Jeetu Singh, live percussion, and dance instruction for all levels. The event is described as a family-friendly celebration of music, movement, local arts, and food vendors.

events.name: The Mavericks & Friends
events.tagline: The Mavericks bring their classic songs and guest vocalists to Durham for one night only.
events.description: The Mavericks & Friends is a live music event at Carolina Theatre of Durham on Friday, July 31, 2026 at 8:00 PM. The show features The Mavericks performing songs from across their career with guest singers including Emily West and James Otto.

events.name: Passion Pit - The Pretty Penny Tour
events.tagline: Passion Pit brings The Pretty Penny Tour to The Ritz for a Friday night concert.
events.description: Passion Pit performs The Pretty Penny Tour at The Ritz in Raleigh on Friday, July 31, 2026. The listing shows a 7:00 PM start, with the show at a general-admission concert venue.

events.name: Comedy Show: Cyrus Steele + Joe Perrow
events.tagline: A night of stand-up comedy at The Cary Theater.
events.description: Stand-up comedy featuring Cyrus Steele with Joe Perrow at The Cary Theater in downtown Cary. The show is scheduled for Friday, July 31, 2026 at 8:00 PM with an approximate runtime of two hours.

events.name: Club XCX: Charli XCX + Hyperpop Night
events.tagline: A 21+ Charli XCX and hyperpop dance party at Motorco.
events.description: What The Dance presents a Charli XCX-themed hyperpop dance party featuring DJs playing Charli XCX, Billie Eilish, Slayyyter, Troye Sivan, Kim Petras, and more. The event is 21+ and runs at Motorco Music Hall in Durham.

events.name: Performances at the Page: Celebration of Bluegrass 2026
events.tagline: A free bluegrass concert in the Page-Walker garden with family-friendly music and local talent.
events.description: Part of the Town of Cary’s Performances at the Page series, this bluegrass concert is presented in partnership with PineCone and includes an opening performance by student musicians from Bluegrass Jam Camp. The event takes place at the Page-Walker Arts & History Center and is free to the public.

events.name: NC Courage Tailgate
events.tagline: A free pre-match hangout for Courage fans with games, music, and community energy.
events.description: The NC Courage Tailgate is a community pre-match gathering at Fenton Square in Cary with a family-friendly atmosphere ahead of the North Carolina Courage game. Listings describe it as featuring socializing and fan activities before kickoff.

events.name: North Carolina Courage vs. Orlando Pride
events.tagline: NWSL action as the Courage host the Pride in Cary.
events.venue: First Horizon Stadium at WakeMed Soccer Park
events.description: North Carolina Courage host Orlando Pride in a 2026 NWSL regular-season match at WakeMed Soccer Park in Cary. The match is scheduled for Friday night at 8:00 PM.

events.name: Derrick Stroup
events.tagline: Stand-up comedian Derrick Stroup brings a multi-show weekend to Goodnights Comedy Club.
events.description: Derrick Stroup appears at Goodnights Comedy Club in Raleigh for Friday shows during his weekend run. The venue lists this as an 18+ show with a two-item minimum in the showroom.

events.name: Mason James
events.tagline: Mason James brings quick, self-deprecating comedy to Room 861 for a weekend run.
events.description: Mason James is scheduled at Goodnights Comedy Club in Raleigh with Friday through Sunday shows in Room 861. Goodnights notes this show is 18+ and has a two-item minimum in the showroom.

events.name: Andrew Orolfo
events.tagline: Stand-up from Andrew Orolfo at Raleigh Improv.
events.description: Andrew Orolfo is scheduled for two shows at Raleigh Improv in Cary on Friday, July 31, 2026. The venue lists showtimes at 7:00 PM and 9:15 PM.

events.name: Dale Jones
events.tagline: Stand-up comedian Dale Jones brings a three-show run to Raleigh Improv in Cary.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 7:00 PM · Sat 6:30 PM · Sun 6:00 PM
events.description: Dale Jones is scheduled for three shows at Raleigh Improv in Cary over the weekend of July 31 to August 2, 2026. The venue calendar lists performances on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.

events.name: Shortest Straw (Metallica tribute) & Undertow. (Tool Tribute)
events.tagline: Two heavy-hitting tribute bands bring Metallica and Tool to Lincoln Theatre.
events.freeNote: $16.25 advance; $22.25 day of; $17.55 to $178.25 listed range
events.description: A live concert featuring tribute performances to Metallica by Shortest Straw and to Tool by Undertow. The show is scheduled at Lincoln Theatre in Raleigh on Friday, July 31, 2026.

events.name: House of Heavy - NuMetal & Metalcore Night
events.tagline: A high-energy night of nu metal and metalcore anthems.
events.description: House of Heavy is a live music event featuring nu metal, metalcore, emo, and alternative metal. It is scheduled for Friday, July 31, 2026 at Chapel of Bones in Raleigh.

events.name: Mascons with The Jason Byerly Project
events.tagline: A Friday night rock lineup at Slim's Dive Bar.
events.description: Mascons with The Jason Byerly Project is scheduled for Friday, July 31, 2026 from 8:00 to 10:00 PM at Slim's Dive Bar in Raleigh. The event listing also mentions The Spectacles and LOSER as part of the lineup.

events.name: Tease in the Seas - Burlesque and Drag Show
events.tagline: A lively burlesque and drag performance at The Pinhook.
events.description: Tease in the Seas is a burlesque and drag show scheduled at The Pinhook in Durham on Friday, July 31, 2026. Downtown Durham Inc lists the event from 8:00 to 10:00 PM.

events.name: SHARK WEEK Hoo Ha Ha
events.tagline: A free Shark Week celebration with themed cocktails, games, and sharky fun at DSSOLVR.
events.description: Shark Week Hoo Ha Ha is a Shark Week-themed event at DSSOLVR in Durham with screenings, themed cocktails, a photobooth, carnival game, and snack bags. The event listing says it runs Friday, July 31 from 12:00 PM to 10:00 PM and is free to attend.

events.name: The Big Sham: The Whom w/ Tributes to The Beatles, The Kinks, & Alabama Shakes
events.tagline: A Friday night tribute bill at The Pour House with The Whom fronting classic rock homages.
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
events.description: The Big Sham features The Whom performing alongside tributes to The Beatles, The Kinks, and Alabama Shakes. The show is scheduled at The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop in Raleigh on Friday, July 31, 2026.

events.name: Last Fridays & The Art Walk
events.tagline: A free, town-wide Friday evening of art, music, and makers in downtown Hillsborough.
events.description: Last Fridays & The Art Walk is a free monthly celebration in downtown Hillsborough featuring artist receptions, live music, and makers markets. In July 2026, the event is scheduled for Friday, July 31, with activity centered at the Old Orange County Courthouse lawn and around town.

events.name: Shop Like A Chef
events.tagline: A hands-on workshop that teaches chef-style systems for your grocery list, pantry, and budget.
events.description: Shop Like A Chef is a 90-minute hands-on workshop at KKG Headquarters in Durham. It focuses on restaurant-style kitchen systems for everyday home cooking, including meal planning, cost per portion, and smarter grocery shopping.

events.name: Beach Cabana In Havana (1940s Speakeasy)
events.tagline: A 1940s Havana-inspired speakeasy night at Boxcar Bar + Arcade.
events.description: This event is listed as a 1940s speakeasy-themed night at Boxcar Bar + Arcade in Durham. The Facebook event is the only source provided for event details, so the exact schedule and pricing are not confirmed.

events.name: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
events.tagline: A Friday-night cult screening with live shadow-cast energy at The Rialto.
events.description: A screening of the cult classic film at The Rialto Theatre in Raleigh, presented on Friday night with a live, interactive audience atmosphere. The venue listing shows doors at 7:30 PM and showtime at 8:00 PM, with general admission priced at $11.

events.name: Splash Bash
events.tagline: A free Friday evening of summer fun and water play at Pleasant Park.
events.description: Celebrate the end of PRCR Month with Splash Bash at Pleasant Park in Apex. The event features an evening of play, community activities, and summertime fun.

events.name: Zebulon Devil Dogz vs. Morehead City Marlins
events.tagline: A home Friday night baseball game at Five County Stadium.
events.description: The Zebulon Devil Dogz host the Morehead City Marlins in a home baseball game at Five County Stadium. First pitch is scheduled for 6:30 PM on Friday, July 31, 2026.

events.name: Clue (High School Edition)
events.tagline: A madcap teen-led whodunit at Raleigh Little Theatre.
events.description: Raleigh Little Theatre presents Clue (High School Edition) as part of its Teens on Stage and Teens Backstage program. The production runs July 24-August 9, 2026 in the Gaddy-Goodwin Teaching Theatre with performances on Fridays and Saturdays at 7:30 PM and Sundays at 3:00 PM.

events.name: BEST OF Mad Lab
events.tagline: A best-of improv showcase from ComedyWorx.
events.freeNote: $0.00 RSVP option available; this is not a free ticket
events.description: A one-night best-of Mad Lab show at ComedyWorx in Raleigh. The listing for this event shows a 10:00 PM start time and tickets are required.

events.name: DAMNNSOLO Artist Showcase
events.tagline: An artist showcase at The Portal HQ.
events.description: DAMNNSOLO Artist Showcase is scheduled for Friday at The Portal HQ in Raleigh. The listing appears to be a ticketed arts event, but no additional public details were available from the provided source.

events.name: Daniell Carrol & Bubba James
events.tagline: Live honky-tonk country at Raleigh’s country bar.
events.description: Daniell Carroll and Bubba James are listed on the Friday live-music lineup at Uncle Jessie’s Honkytonk in Raleigh. The venue describes itself as a live country music and honky-tonk bar with bands starting at 9:30 PM.

events.name: Monthly Sapphic Night
events.tagline: A monthly sapphic social night at Le Dive in downtown Raleigh.
events.description: Monthly Sapphic Night is a recurring event hosted by Stonewall Sports Raleigh’s DEI Committee at Le Dive in downtown Raleigh. It is presented as a fun night out for sapphic community members.

events.name: Buck and the Preacher
events.tagline: A classic Western screening at The Cary Theater.
events.description: Screening of the film Buck and The Preacher at The Cary Theater in downtown Cary. The theater’s July 2026 schedule lists the show for 8/1 at 2:00 PM at 122 E. Chatham St.

events.name: Día de la Ciencia y la Cultura
events.tagline: A free bilingual celebration blending science, Hispanic heritage, and hands-on discovery.
events.venue: North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences
events.description: This fully bilingual Spanish-English event at the North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences features hands-on science activities, interactive exhibits, music, storytelling, art, and dance. It is open to the public and celebrates Hispanic heritage and community.

events.name: Rhythm & Reels - FREE
events.tagline: Free Saturday night concerts and movies under the stars at Apex Nature Park Amphitheatre.
events.description: Rhythm & Reels is a free summer series at Apex Nature Park Amphitheatre featuring live music on select Saturday evenings, followed by a movie at dusk. The 2026 series runs from June 6 through August 29 at 2600 Evans Road in Apex.

events.name: The Market at NCMA
events.tagline: A free first-Saturday market featuring local artists, live music, and museum views.
events.description: The Market at NCMA is a local artist market held in Gipson Plaza at the North Carolina Museum of Art. It takes place on the first Saturday of the month and includes live music, museum park access, and shopping from local artists and artisans.

events.name: The Myers House | Halloween Replica Film House Visit
events.tagline: Tour a life-size replica of the iconic *Halloween* house in rural Hillsborough.
events.description: The Myers House NC is a life-size replica of the Michael Myers house from John Carpenter’s 1978 film *Halloween*, built and lived in by horror fan Kenny Caperton in rural Hillsborough. Visitors can view the exterior by appointment or during select events hosted at the property.

events.name: Family Studio
events.tagline: A hands-on family art workshop with a gallery tour and studio project.
events.venue: North Carolina Museum of Art; Museum Park, Welcome Center
events.description: Family Studio is a two-hour workshop at the North Carolina Museum of Art for families with children ages 5 to 11. Participants explore artworks with an expert artist, then create their own project in the studio; all materials are included.

events.name: First Saturday Series
events.tagline: A free monthly community morning at Raleigh City Farm with volunteering, learning, and farm fun.
events.scheduleNote: Sat morning; begins Aug 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM
events.description: Raleigh City Farm’s First Saturday Series brings neighbors together for volunteer workdays, farm tours, workshops, and other seasonal activities on the farm. The series runs from May through October and is free to attend, with donations encouraged.

events.name: In Full Bloom: "The Summer Cutting Garden" Flower Workshop with Cheryl Gibson, Vine and Branch
events.tagline: Learn how to grow and arrange armloads of summer blooms in a hands-on flower workshop.
events.venue: Ruby C. McSwain Education Center, JC Raulston Arboretum at NC State University
events.description: A relaxed workshop focused on summer annuals and cutting-garden techniques for North Carolina's hot summers. Participants will learn planting and harvesting tips and make a fresh bouquet to take home, along with free seed packs.

events.name: Summer Native Medicinal Plants: Passionflower
events.tagline: Learn the natural history and herbal uses of passionflower, then take home a cutting.
events.description: An educational workshop at the North Carolina Museum of Art focused on Passiflora incarnata, covering its natural history, ecology, and herbal qualities. Participants learn simple preparations and take home a passionflower cutting.

events.name: Kelariz Keshavarz & Friends Summer Performance
events.tagline: A summer flute recital featuring Kelariz Keshavarz and collaborators at UNC-Chapel Hill.
events.description: A live summer performance presented at Person Recital Hall on the UNC-Chapel Hill campus. The listing identifies Kelariz Keshavarz & Friends as the featured performers.

events.name: Family Movie Nights at Joyner Park
events.tagline: Enjoy a free outdoor movie under the stars with pre-show family activities.
events.scheduleNote: Sat 8:30 PM · pre-show activities begin at 7:30 PM
events.description: Wake Forest Parks, Recreation & Cultural Resources hosts Family Movie Nights at E. Carroll Joyner Park as a free monthly outdoor film series. The event includes movie-related pre-show activities and is open to the public.

events.name: Garden Discovery Hours
events.tagline: Explore seasonal plants and garden highlights on a guided arboretum visit.
events.venue: JC Raulston Arboretum at North Carolina State University
events.scheduleNote: Saturday hours vary by program; check the event page for the exact start time
events.description: Garden Discovery Hours is a public program at the JC Raulston Arboretum in Raleigh. The arboretum is open to the public daily and admission is free.

events.name: Newbie Night at Raleigh Bike Polo
events.tagline: A free intro session for anyone curious about bike polo.
events.description: Monthly beginner-friendly Raleigh Bike Polo event at Tarboro Road Park, presented by Oaks and Spokes. It is listed as a free event and is scheduled for 7 PM.

events.name: Dixie Gun and Knife Show
events.tagline: A large Raleigh gun and knife show with vendors, collectibles, and outdoor gear.
events.venue: Jim Graham Building at North Carolina State Fairgrounds
events.scheduleNote: Sat 9 AM–5 PM · Sun 10 AM–5 PM
events.freeNote: Adults $10; Children 12 & under free with adult
events.description: The Raleigh Gun & Knife Show is scheduled for August 1–2, 2026 at the Jim Graham Building on the North Carolina State Fairgrounds. The show features firearms, knives, shooting supplies, and related outdoor goods, with free parking and children 12 and under admitted free with an adult.

events.name: Club 90s Present MJ night
events.tagline: A high-energy Michael Jackson dance party with nonstop hits and immersive visuals.
events.description: Club 90s Present MJ night is an 18+ dance-focused tribute event celebrating Michael Jackson’s biggest hits, remixes, deep cuts, and classic club tracks. It is scheduled at The Ritz in Raleigh for Saturday, August 1, 2026, with doors at 7:00 PM and showtime at 8:00 PM.

events.name: EMO NIGHT KARAOKE
events.tagline: Sing your favorite emo and pop-punk anthems live with a full band at Motorco.
events.description: Emo Night Karaoke is a live band karaoke show featuring a setlist of 100+ pop punk and emo songs, with audience members singing lead vocals. Motorco lists the event in downtown Durham for Saturday night.

events.name: Born In The Club
events.tagline: A late-night dance party with an exclusive live electronic set at midnight.
events.description: Born In The Club is scheduled for Saturday, August 1, 2026 at Bitter Social - Above Centro in downtown Raleigh. The event runs from 10 PM to 2 AM and is a 21+ dance-focused nightlife event with a live electronic set at midnight.

events.name: Ariana Grande Listening Party
events.tagline: Celebrate Ariana Grande’s new album with a free all-ages listening party at The Pour House.
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
events.description: A free, all-ages record shop listening party for Ariana Grande’s new album 'petal,' with themed drinks, raffle tickets, freebies, and a friendship bracelet-making station. Attendees can hear the album on vinyl and purchase copies on site.

events.name: Beggars Banquet (Rolling Stones) & Petty Larceny (Tom Petty)
events.tagline: A tribute double bill bringing classic rock favorites to Lincoln Theatre.
events.description: Beggars Banquet performs as a Rolling Stones tribute, paired with Petty Larceny performing Tom Petty songs. The show is scheduled at Lincoln Theatre in Raleigh on Saturday, August 1, 2026.

events.name: Taylor Bissette Band
events.tagline: Live country honky-tonk from Taylor Bissette & Co at Uncle Jessie’s.
events.description: Taylor Bissette & Co is listed to play at Uncle Jessie’s Honky Tonk in Raleigh. Uncle Jessie’s lists bands starting at 9:30 PM every night, and the venue operates Saturday evenings in the honky-tonk format.

events.name: The Witch's Carnival
events.tagline: A witchy fundraiser blending a daytime market with an adults-only night of live performance.
events.description: The Witch's Carnival is a fundraising event supporting local mutual aid organizations through community-centered entertainment. Programming includes a daytime market with games, food vendors, and handcrafted goods, followed by an adults-only evening showcase with live music, drag, burlesque, and circus performances.

events.name: Double Tap and Negative Feedback
events.tagline: A local rock bill at Huron Stage featuring two Durham bands.
events.description: Double Tap and Negative Feedback are scheduled to play at Huron Stage Music Venue in Durham. Double Tap was formed in 2025 by Todd Levins, Kelly Stiles, and Jake Severn.

events.name: Moodboard: Alec Lomami / Uymami / HouseDress / Pharmacil b2b UrsoMajor
events.tagline: A Durham club night with a stacked lineup of local and electronic DJs.
events.description: Listed for BOOM Club in Durham as part of the Party Illegal events calendar. The lineup includes Alec Lomami, Uymami, HouseDress, and a Pharmacil b2b UrsoMajor set.

events.name: Tonk and Autopilots Show
events.tagline: Live music night at Wolfe & Porter.
events.description: A live performance listing for Tonk and Autopilots at Wolfe & Porter in Raleigh. The provided source identifies the venue but does not include a published set time, ticket price, or additional event details.

events.name: Verse Versus: Launch Party
events.tagline: A free launch party celebrating a new lyric-based card game.
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
events.description: Verse Versus Launch Party is scheduled for Saturday, August 1 at The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop in Raleigh. The event is described as a free Raleigh gathering celebrating a new lyric-based card game.

events.name: Döltz with Gown, Cyprian, and a Secret Set
events.tagline: An intimate Saturday night showcase with a surprise set in Raleigh.
events.description: Döltz appears with Gown, Cyprian, and a secret set at KINGS in Raleigh. The event is listed for Saturday, August 1, 2026.

events.name: The SwanBean Quintet: A Straight-Ahead Jazz Expression
events.tagline: A straight-ahead jazz set from the SwanBean Quintet at Sharp 9 Gallery.
events.description: The SwanBean Quintet presents a straight-ahead jazz performance at The Durham Jazz Workshop/Sharp 9 Gallery in Durham. Discover Durham lists the event for Saturday, August 1 at 7:00 PM, with student and adult admission prices.

events.name: Holy Wave w/ Vulture Twin
events.tagline: Psych-rock and indie support hit The Pinhook for a Saturday night set.
events.description: Holy Wave is scheduled to perform with Vulture Twin at The Pinhook in Durham on Saturday, August 1, 2026. Discover Durham lists the show from 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM at The Pinhook.

events.tagline: Live music at Abbey Road Tavern & Grill in Cary.
events.description: An event listing at Abbey Road Tavern & Grill in Cary. The venue is a live-music bar and grill at 1195 W Chatham St, and this listing is scheduled for Saturday.

events.name: Watermelon Festival
events.tagline: A free summer farm festival with live music, contests, and watermelon fun.
events.description: McLean Farms’ annual Watermelon Festival takes place at the farm in Fuquay-Varina and features live music, watermelon-themed contests, local vendors, and family activities. The event is scheduled for Saturday, August 1, from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

events.name: Girls Summer Soirée
events.tagline: A summer shopping social spotlighting local women-owned businesses at Boxyard RTP.
events.description: Girls Summer Soirée is a Saturday event at Boxyard RTP in Durham featuring a lineup of local female-owned small businesses. The listing highlights shopping for items such as fashion, books, charms, and jewelry.

events.name: GRL Market
events.tagline: A pop-up market spotlighting women-owned brands at Waverly Place.
events.description: GRL Market is a monthly pop-up series featuring women-owned brands at Waverly Place in Cary. The event is listed as free admission and is scheduled for Saturday morning.

events.name: Dog Days of Summer
events.tagline: A summer-themed community event for dog lovers.
events.description: A local event titled Dog Days of Summer at SG Supply Co. in Raleigh. The provided listing does not include published schedule, pricing, or activity details.

events.name: Holly Springs Salamanders vs. Martinsville Mustangs
events.tagline: Coastal Plain League baseball at Ting Stadium in Holly Springs.
events.description: The Holly Springs Salamanders host the Martinsville Mustangs in a Coastal Plain League game at North Main Athletic Complex Stadium. The listing shows a 6:30 PM start on Saturday, August 1, 2026.

events.name: Puppy Patio Party at Morgan Street Food Hall
events.tagline: An adoptable-puppy patio hangout with snuggles and good vibes.
events.description: A recurring monthly event on the first Saturday at Morgan Street Food Hall featuring adoptable puppies, puppy snuggles, and an outdoor patio atmosphere. Visit Raleigh lists the event as free and scheduled from 2 to 5 PM.

events.name: Once Upon a One More Time
events.tagline: Britney Spears hits and fairy-tale heroines collide in a student-produced musical at Theatre Raleigh.
events.description: Theatre Raleigh ACT Performance Company Students present 'Once Upon a One More Time' at De Ann S. Jones Theatre. The production runs July 24-August 1, with Friday and Saturday performances at 7:30 PM.

events.name: Bourbon & Charcuterie
events.tagline: A 21+ bourbon and charcuterie pairing experience at Mystic Farm & Distillery.
events.description: This event pairs curated charcuterie with Mystic bourbons and includes a tasting of the distillery’s bourbon lineup. Guests also get a behind-the-scenes look at where the spirits are crafted and aged.

events.name: Sunset Float
events.tagline: Paddle Falls Lake at sunset for a relaxed evening on the water.
events.description: A guided sunset paddle with Two Sisters Adventure Company on Falls Lake. The trip lasts about 2 hours and includes paddling equipment; participants should bring a headlamp or flashlight.

events.name: 2026 Summer Concert Series
events.tagline: Free Sunday evening live music in Fred Fletcher Park.
events.description: The City of Raleigh’s free Summer Concert Series features local performers at Fred Fletcher Park on select Sunday evenings. Concerts run from 6 to 8 p.m., and attendees are asked to bring a blanket or chair.

events.name: Derek Hough
events.tagline: Emmy-winning dancer Derek Hough brings his latest live dance spectacular to DPAC.
events.address: 123 Vivian Street / William V. "Bill" Bell Way
events.description: Derek Hough presents Symphony of Dance: Encore at DPAC in Durham on Sunday, August 2, 2026. The performance begins at 8:00 PM, with lobby doors opening at 7:00 PM.

events.name: Bubble Fest
events.tagline: A free, family-friendly bubble celebration with vendors, music, and food at Moore Square.
events.freeNote: Free admission; Bubble Garden tickets required for some activities ($8 in advance, $10 at the event)
events.description: Bubble Fest is a family-friendly outdoor event at Moore Square featuring bubble activities, local vendors, live music, food trucks, face painting, and other hands-on fun. The festival admission is free, with separate paid Bubble Garden access for some bubble experiences.

events.name: Durham Fiesta Latina
events.tagline: A free community festival celebrating Latino culture with music, dance, food, and family activities.
events.description: Durham Fiesta Latina is an annual free festival at Durham Central Park featuring live Latin music, folkloric dance, authentic food vendors, local artisans, and family-friendly activities. The 2026 event is scheduled for Saturday, August 2, from 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM.

events.name: Mori no Karasu Pop Up Dinner
events.tagline: A one-night pop-up dinner at Boatman Spirits Co.
events.description: A pop-up dinner hosted at Boatman Spirits Co. in Raleigh. The listing is for a Sunday reservation-based event and appears to be ticketed through Resy.

events.name: Monthly Pop Shop ARTernative Market
events.tagline: A free monthly art market featuring local makers, handmade goods, and community vibes at Chapel of Bones.
events.description: Monthly Pop Shop ARTernative Market is a recurring all-ages art market at Chapel of Bones in Raleigh. It features local creators and makers, with food and beverages available on site.

events.name: Meet the Artists: Fine Arts League of Cary
events.tagline: Meet local artists and see the Fine Arts League of Cary’s juried exhibition at Page-Walker.
events.description: A free public reception for the Fine Arts League of Cary’s annual juried exhibition at the Page-Walker Arts and History Center. Guests can meet participating artists and view the artwork on display during the reception.

events.name: Angelo Colina - This show is completely in Spanish with no translation
events.tagline: A Spanish-language stand-up set with no translation.
events.description: Angelo Colina presents a stand-up comedy performance at Goodnights Comedy Club in Raleigh. The show is completely in Spanish with no translation and is scheduled for Sunday at 7 PM.

events.name: Cary Underground Market
events.tagline: A free monthly market and live-music series with local makers, food, and bands.
events.description: The MAKRS Society and Oak City Music Collective present a monthly market and concert series at Bond Brothers Beer Company. The event features 40+ local vendors, live musicians or bands, and food trucks.

events.name: The Land Before Time
events.tagline: A family-friendly dino classic screening at The Cary Theater.
events.description: The Cary Theater’s Summer Family Series includes a screening of The Land Before Time on Sunday, August 2, 2026 at 12:00 PM. The film is presented as a retro family-friendly movie for audiences of all ages.

events.name: The Bleeding Hearts Sunday Funday Album Release: w/ The Blusterfields, The You're Gonna Die And Go To Hells
events.tagline: A Sunday album release show with a stacked local bill at The Pour House.
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
events.description: The Bleeding Hearts headline an album release show with support from The Blusterfields and The You're Gonna Die And Go To Hells. The event is listed for Sunday, August 2, 2026 at The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop in downtown Raleigh.

events.name: Loser
events.tagline: Live music at Slim’s Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh.
events.description: Loser is listed as a live music event at Slim’s Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh. The venue is located at 227 S Wilmington St and the event is scheduled for Sunday, August 2, 2026, from 8:00 to 10:00 PM.

events.name: Fly Anakin / Nickelus F with Mutant Academy
events.tagline: A Sunday night of Richmond underground hip-hop at KINGS.
events.description: Fly Anakin and Nickelus F are scheduled to perform with Mutant Academy at KINGS in Raleigh on Sunday, August 2, 2026. Fly Anakin is a Richmond rapper and co-founder of Mutant Academy.

events.name: ChewieCatt w/ DJ Silva Hound/NemRaps/Ben Schuller/DizzyEight/NerdOut
events.tagline: A Sunday night nerdcore showcase led by ChewieCatt at Lincoln Theatre.
events.freeNote: $40.95 advance; $46.25 day of; VIP Meet & Greet $114.25
events.description: ChewieCatt appears with DJ Silva Hound, NemRaps, Ben Schuller, DizzyEight, and NerdOut at Lincoln Theatre in Raleigh. The event is scheduled for Sunday, August 2, with doors at 6:00 PM and showtime at 6:30 PM.

events.name: 5th Annual Kids Fest
events.tagline: A free family day with bounce houses, face painting, vendors, food trucks, and crafts.
events.description: Kids Fest is a free, all-ages community event hosted at Fortnight Brewing Company in Cary. It features a bounce house, face painting, local vendors, food trucks, crafts, and free goodie bags for the first 200 kids.

events.name: Sunday DRIFT Rooftop DJ Series
events.tagline: Free Sunday rooftop DJ sets with skyline views at The Velvet Hippo.
events.description: Weekly Sunday rooftop DJ sets at The Velvet Hippo in downtown Durham. The series features rotating resident DJs, runs from 4 to 7 PM, and is free to attend for guests 21 and older.

events.name: Drinks & MiniFigs
events.tagline: Build a custom minifig while sipping a drink at Ment Beverage Co.
events.description: Make a personalized mini figure with Bricks & MiniFigs of Durham while enjoying a drink at Ment Beverage Co. Admission is $10 and includes one drink; additional figures can be purchased.

events.name: NC Cider, Wine & Cheese Pairing | Meet the Makers
events.tagline: A guided tasting of North Carolina cider, wine, and cheese with the makers on hand.
events.description: This ticketed tasting features curated pairings of North Carolina wine, cider, and cheese, along with other NC-based accompaniments. Guests can meet the makers and sample both classic and newer items featured at Weaver Street Market.

events.name: Kelly Reidy | Harp in the Dark
events.tagline: An intimate electric-harp set that turns ambient textures into a meditative live performance.
events.description: Kelly Reidy performs 'Harp in the Dark' at ArtsCenter in Carrboro. The set features electric-harp music with gentle, meditative interpretations and effects-driven textures.

events.name: Blueberry Brunch
events.tagline: A seasonal Sunday brunch centered on fresh blueberries at The Honeysuckle Tea House.
events.description: Blueberry Brunch is a seasonal event at The Honeysuckle Tea House in Chapel Hill. The venue is a farm-based tea house and event space on Pickards Meadow Road, and it operates seasonally during the warmer months.

events.name: Zebulon Devil Dogz vs. Yorktown Coconuts
events.tagline: Coastal Plain League baseball returns to Five County Stadium.
events.description: The Zebulon Devil Dogz host the Yorktown Coconuts at Five County Stadium in Zebulon. The game is scheduled for Sunday, August 2, 2026 at 5:00 PM.

events.name: Holly Springs Salamanders vs. South Wake Shakes
events.tagline: Summer baseball in Holly Springs as the Salamanders host the South Wake Shakes.
events.description: A Holly Springs Salamanders home baseball game against the South Wake Shakes at North Main Athletic Complex in Holly Springs. The listed start time is 5:05 PM on Sunday, August 2, 2026.
